source_documents.title: Solvatochromic multi-colour fluorescence driven by thiol-type ESIPT in a 1-mercapto-naphthaldiimide compound

reference_evidence_units.quote: A novel thiol (SH)-type excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) compound, 1SNT-IC, was designed and synthesized.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: The S-H group next to the imide carbonyl is the proton donor (S-H...O=C).

reference_evidence_units.quote: Another FL at 649 nm is attributed to T* via ESIPT
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Dual emission: N* at 490 nm (0.30 ns) and T* at 649 nm (Stokes shift 7216 cm-1, 0.55 ns).

reference_evidence_units.quote: smooth tautomerisation from N* to T*
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated N* 387 nm and T* 533 nm emission with a downhill N*-to-T* path (-0.78 eV).

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results strongly support the structural basis for the potential ESIPT ability in the excited state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Split C=O stretches reproduce the calculated intramolecular S-H...O=C hydrogen bond.

reference_evidence_units.quote: It was suggested that ESIPT occurs in all solvents, including DMSO, with notably different emission colours between T* and A* depending on the solvent polarity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: ESIPT persists in all solvents; the N*/T* ratio changes with polarity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: After the addition of an organic base (DBU), an anionic (A*) state appeared, leading to a multi-colour emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Deprotonation gives a third, anion emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: With increasing solvent polarity, the FL lifetimes increased, and the quantum yields of T* and A* decreased due to the stabilisation of the T* and A* states.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: T* and A* yields fall in polar solvents.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Whether in solid or dispersed films, naphthalene moieties tend to induce strong intermolecular interactions due to their enlarged p-conjugation, leading to an overall decrease in FL quantum yield.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1SNT-IC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Low solid/film yields (about 0.5-5%) blamed on intermolecular interactions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: General remark; no aggregate species identified.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Thiol-type ESIPT (S-H...O=C): a large-Stokes-shift T* emission alongside N*, supported by TD-DFT and FT-IR evidence for the hydrogen bond; ESIPT persists in all solvents; base gives an anion emission.
